craft_notes: CLOSING MAṄGALA (mirrors v1 invocation; guru-mouth lineage claimed). Sthāyin: bowing-joy. Sanskrit first: five epithets + purpose + bow → L4 keeps all five uncut across the break, bow closes. Rows: row 2 (epithets whole — never split the praise); row 1 (compare-last — śivam closes as compare closes). Rupture: comma after rain — praised, bowed. Close: end-weight on the taught-loveliness (guru-mouth last word but one — lineage audible). Minimal pass: 'rain' for darśaka? No — L4 'own form's rain' mistranslates darśaka (shower)! FIX: darśaka = showing. L4 line must read 'showing own form'. Revise line 1: 'Whole-blessing maker, wildfire to deeds, showing own form,'. Read aloud: five praises, purpose, bow. Rejected: 'guru-taught' short — kept? L4 'guru-taught' vs 'taught by guru mouth' — mouth kept? MUST keep mouth (mukha): revise to 'guru-mouth-taught'.

lines: Whole-blessing maker, wildfire to deeds, showing own form,
fancy-free, all-joy's temple — I bow to Śiva, guru-mouth-taught, lovely past compare.
